title: Database and warehouse security: one decision trace
teachingQuestion: What does database and warehouse security require beyond completing a technical action?
focalInsight: Combine parameterized data access with object/row authorization, least privilege, auditing and appropriate retention/minimization.
caption: Follow the concept from meaning to the decision condition and its concrete failure consequence.
